title: Russian Strikes on Sumy and Mykolaiv Kill Four Civilians
detail: Russian forces carried out missile and drone strikes against Sumy and Mykolaiv on August 4, 2026, part of an escalating exchange of long-range strikes between Russia and Ukraine. At least four civilians were killed in Ukraine as Russia intensified its aerial campaign; Ukrainian air defenses intercepted a portion of the incoming wave. Russia's spring-summer 2026 ground offensive has failed to produce operationally significant gains more than two and a half months after it began, per ISW.

media.caption: Long-range strikes between Russia and Ukraine killed nine people on August 4, 2026

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Wildberries Warehouses and Syzran Oil Refinery in Russia
detail: Ukraine's SBU said its drone operators carried out over 100 strikes against strategic Russian targets on August 4, including Wildberries logistics warehouses in the Moscow region, Tver region, and near St. Petersburg, plus the Syzran Oil Refinery in Samara region. Five people were killed in Russia, including in a Moscow-region warehouse strike that killed five and injured ten. The Wildberries campaign targets a company Ukraine says materially supports Russia's war effort.

media.caption: Ukrainian drone strikes hit Wildberries warehouses and the Syzran oil refinery in Russia
